name: set_interpolation_value_type

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetInterpolationValueType consumes a value ID and interpolation type, resolves D_0038858C[value_id], stores the type at offset 0 of that Interpolation value, and decrements Script stackTop by two

notes: The only JP call sets value 0 to type 1 immediately after command 155 allocates that value.
